notes.title: iTop Easy Desktop 2.9 Update – Performance Boosts & Anti-Virus Fix!
notes.notes:
Hi, there, 
We’re excited to announce the release of iTop Easy Desktop 2.9! We’ve addressed some known issues for a more stable experience.

Here’s what’s new in this update:
+ Optimized the auto organization logic for Boxes and added related settings
+ Optimized the display of snapshot details
+ Optimized the logic to display the IED launching window better 
+ Enhanced Widgets to support excluding widgets from Quick Hide
+ Fixed known issues

Update now to enjoy these improvements and keep your desktop experience optimized!

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 27
notes.notes:
New features
Added Snapshot to back up & restore desktops and Settings

Boxes
Supported opening subdirectories directly in Folder Portal

Wallpapers
Supported setting up the play time for each live wallpaper in Playlist 
Optimized the play logic in battery mode

Widgets
Fancy Taskbar fully supports Windows 11
More options for Schedule: mark as completed and set the first day of a week
Clock supports displaying time in 12/24-hour format 

Others
Optimized search logic for more accurate results
Optimized UI (guide for creating rules, wallpapers & widgets) for better user experience
Fixed minor bugs
